name: @homebell/contracts
description: HomeBell API contract v1 (OpenAPI 3.1 + AsyncAPI 3.0) and generated TypeScript types. Single source of truth (ADR-0004).

scripts.generate: pnpm run bundle && openapi-typescript --enum-values --alphabetize && node scripts/generate.mjs && prettier --write src/generated ERROR_CODES.md
scripts.check: pnpm run generate && git diff --exit-code -- bundled src/generated ERROR_CODES.md
